name: Kai'Sa
notes: Skill max order is Q > E > W on Patch 16.21, matching Kai'Sa's standard marksman skill order across AD, On-Hit, and Hybrid builds since Void Seeker's upgrade comes from item AP while Supercharge rank scales attack speed from 40% to 80% and cooldown from 16 s to 10 s.

Living Weapon evolutions are evaluated dynamically from each build's permanent stats at its level rather than assumed always on: Icathian Rain upgrades from 6 to 12 missiles at 100 permanent bonus AD plus level AD growth (sheet.ad minus level-1 base AD 59), Void Seeker upgrades from 2 to 3 Plasma stacks and refunds 75% cooldown on champion hit at 100 permanent item AP (counting Rabadon's permanent 30% AP multiplier while excluding Blackfire Torch's temporary 4% in-combat AP), and Supercharge's 100% bonus AS upgrade (0.5 s invisibility) has no dummy damage effect.

Second Skin (P) applies 1 Plasma stack on each basic attack on-hit (4 s duration, refreshed on reapplication), dealing Caustic Wounds magic damage. At 4 held stacks, a basic attack evaluates the 5th-stack Caustic Wounds hit and the missing-health detonation (15% + 6% per 100 AP, uncapped against champions) before the basic attack's own damage, while extra on-hit applications from Guinsoo's Phantom Hit or Dusk and Dawn apply additional stacks afterward.

Icathian Rain (Q) has no cast time, does not interrupt basic attacks, and can be cast while charging Supercharge (waiting only if Void Seeker is mid-cast). It fires 6 or 12 discrete physical missiles across a 1.0 s volley starting 0.4 s after cast: the first missile deals 100% damage and triggers once-per-cast procs (Muramana, Eclipse, and 1 Spear of Shojin stack), while subsequent missiles deal 25% persistent-area ability damage and stack physical shreds such as Black Cleaver individually.

Void Seeker (W) uses the live V26.13 cooldown array [20, 18.5, 17, 15.5, 14] from the wiki and ddragon (over the stale bin field) with a 0.4 s cast time, woven into basic-attack backswings so imminent attacks are not clipped unless an immediate bolt executes faster. At cast completion it deals bolt magic damage first, then applies 2 (unevolved) or 3 (evolved) Plasma stacks successively, detonating immediately upon reaching the 5th stack before rolling over any remaining stacks, and starts its cooldown with the 75% champion-hit refund when evolved.

Supercharge (E) uses the live dynamic charge time max(1.2 / (1 + bonusAS / 100), 0.6) s from current bonus attack speed (over the stale 1.5 s bin field), disarming attacks and Void Seeker during the charge and then granting 40% to 80% bonus attack speed and reduced 0.1 / 1.552 (6.44%) attack windup for 4 s, while basic attacks shave 0.5 s off E's remaining cooldown on-attack. Instead of charging blindly on cooldown, the driver aligns E into an attack backswing and skips E whenever AS-cap saturation makes the charge a net attack loss or continuing to attack kills the target before E's post-charge speed buff catches up.

Killer Instinct (R) has no cast time, requires the target to have been affected by Plasma within the last 4 s, and resets Kai'Sa's basic-attack timer (its shield and dash have no dummy damage effect). When use_ult is enabled, R is armed rather than wasted at t = 0 before Plasma exists, then fires immediately after an attack once Plasma is active (holding briefly for Spellblade's 1.5 s cooldown when a Sheen item is equipped without ult-steroid items and the target survives that window).
Mana costs are not modeled: none of Kai'Sa's costs constrain casting within a fight.
_provenance: Updated 2026-11-03 from Patch 16.21 sources (dossiers/kaisa.json, wiki.json, sheet.json, bin.json): Q > E > W skill order, dynamic Living Weapon Q/W evolutions from permanent stats, discrete 6/12-missile Icathian Rain volleys, pre-auto and Void Seeker rollover Plasma detonation ordering, Killer Instinct post-Plasma attack reset, and adaptive Supercharge backswing/cap/lethal gating in engine/src/generated/kaisa.rs.
